t: Everbuild 507 Rendagrip 10Ltr is a quick drying, extra-grip render bonding agent designed for preparing external surfaces. The red solution is ideal for trade professionals working on concrete, lightweight blockwork, and brick substrates. Features fine aggregates suspended in a waterproof polymer, creating an improved mechanical key for render application. The formulation ensures easy application by roller or brush, promoting an even spread of aggregate and preventing weak spots in the key coat. Also reduces the porosity and suction of the base substrate, ensuring a strong and reliable bond.
b: Contains Fine Aggregate For Strong Bond
